$comment: The source of sf-steps's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/steps (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

size.summary: The rung: 1, or 1/2 for dense cards and panels. The marker is the rung's text line (24 at 1, 20 at 1/2 on a desktop).

items.summary: The steps in order, as JSON: {label, text?, state?, disabled?}. text is the second line a column shows (a date, a time, «optional», the reason of an error). state is the step's own: done, skipped, running or error, or ahead for a step before current that was never done; without it the place decides (before current: done, at current: current, after: ahead). completed and default are the former words of done and ahead, read until 2027-01-01.
items.x-markup: the attribute also takes the former string form "label::flag|label" (flags disabled, completed, skipped, running, error), read until 2027-01-01 and noted in SF.deprecations

marker.summary: What marks a step: its number (a check when done, «!» on an error), or a dot for a passive status and dense cards. The same three shapes either way: filled done, filled with a ring current, empty ahead.

layout.summary: auto: a row while the steps fit their own width on one line, else a column (label and a second line); under 20rem of its own width the count line «Шаг N из M · label» over sf-progress-bar. row, column and count draw that layout always; an explicit row wider than its place scrolls inside itself.

navigation.summary: Empty: the steps are a passive list, nothing is pressed. visited: a step behind current, or one done, skipped or failed, is a button that moves there; free: every step not disabled is. As in sf-wizard; the current step is never a button.

error-step.summary: The former way to mark one step failed (sf-steps 1.3 and before): read until 2027-01-01 and noted in SF.deprecations. Today an item says state "error".

separator-icon.summary: Former: the glyph between steps (chevron_right). Since 1.4.0 steps are joined by a line and the setting is ignored; noted in SF.deprecations, removed after 2027-01-01.

completed-label.summary: The word a screen reader hears after a done step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Completed" in English).

current-label.summary: The word a screen reader hears after a current step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Current" in English).

ahead-label.summary: The word a screen reader hears after a not yet started step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Not started" in English).

error-label.summary: The word a screen reader hears after a failed step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Error" in English).

skipped-label.summary: The word a screen reader hears after a skipped step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Skipped" in English).

running-label.summary: The word a screen reader hears after a running step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("In progress" in English).

count-label.summary: The count line's position, {n} and {count} filled in. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Step {n} of {count}" in English).

current.summary: The current step, from 0. Equal to the number of steps: all are done and none is current.

go-to-step.summary: Moves current to the step at index, clamped to the list; refuses a disabled or the current step. It moves whatever navigation says (navigation is what a person may press). Sends no sf-steps-change: that is a person's press.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-steps for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split (the old detail from the element's adapter), host-attribute (no shim).

rows.note: the old detail adds component, tagName and template, which §8 takes out of the new one: the element's detail adapter makes it

x-summary: Where a person is in an ordered process of their own: a list of steps, each a marker (number or dot) and a label joined by a progress line, drawn as a row, a column or a «Step N of M» line by its own width. Passive by default; navigation makes the reachable steps buttons.
x-renamed: settings.items: type string with a list default → list (§4.2)
settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.change: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-step-change → change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
settings.error-step: a string holding an index → number, nullable (§16 item 29)
events.sf-step-change → change: the DOM name is sf-steps-change (§8 <tag>-<verb>); the old name is a dated split alias whose detail keeps component, tagName and template
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0, a minor while sf-step-change holds a dated alias (§4.10); the major comes with the sweep after 2026-12-01.

events: the person's move is `change`, sent as sf-steps-change (§8: a component's own verb is <tag>-<verb>; `carries: native` would make it the DOM change that an inner field's change also reaches the host by). The migration's alias row to the bare `change` is corrected to sf-steps-change.

detail-adapter: §8 takes the element out of detail, so sf-steps-change carries {previous, current, item, items}; the old sf-step-change keeps its old detail (component, tagName, template added) through a split row and sfAliasAdapters, sent once after the new name.
change reports a person (§8): pressing a step sends it; go-to-step and writing current do not, as for native fields. The studio scenario asserts the attribute instead of the event.

actions: go-to-step {index} answers an outcome (applied; refused with disabled, current or out-of-range) instead of the element (§4.4: chaining is not part of the interface). setState and onStepChange stay as the base's and the component's helpers, not interface members.

key-effects: the steps are native buttons, so Enter and Space press the focused step (select) and Tab reaches each enabled one; the list has no roving focus and no arrow keys (role list, 1.3.0; role group before).
a11y-name: aria-label on the host, else the language file's runtime word «Шаги» / «Steps» (aria-label stays a host attribute, §3.1).
item-shape: items are {label, disabled?}; the attribute keeps the "label::disabled|label" form and also takes the list as JSON.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus a completed and an error step and the half size; probe.json drives Tab, Enter and Space (gate 16).

css-variables: seven public variables read by the class sheets (component/step) with the role tokens as fallbacks (§6): the gap, the separator, a step's label, border and radius at rest, the current step's border and the completed mark. They are not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json yet: that file is shared with the field family's branches.
side-effects: none.
docs: docs/docs.md, where the folder keeps it (as sf-tooltip); the fold into the folder's docs.md is §16 item 30's.

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (sf-wizard, owner decision 2026-11-06, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-06-sf-wizard.md): an item may carry its own state -- default (not started), completed, skipped, running or error -- which wins over the one derived from its place (before current: completed; error-step: error). skipped and running are new. skipped: a step a person passed over on purpose, the do_not_disturb_on glyph in on-surface-variant. running: the step's action is under way, the progress_activity glyph in on-surface-variant, turning (still under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). The icon roles are on-surface, on-surface-variant and on-disable; completed and error keep their status colours. Each new state is named in the step's accessible name (skipped-label «Пропущен» / «Skipped», running-label «Выполняется» / «In progress»). A wizard passes a state for every step, so a step before current that was never done reads as not started. The string form takes the states as flags (label::skipped). Additions only: a minor.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives the action's method its one object argument, goToStep({index}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object); the element's code also takes the value alone, goToStep(<number>), and the reference says so (x-registry.action-calls). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-10, docs pre-check, through component.step 1.2.0): a patch. A step is a size 1 control on the height ladder (C01, C18): 40 on a desktop and 36 on a phone, size 1/2 at the 1/2 step; it was 34 on a desktop and 34 and 30 in one row on a phone. The current step is the selected role (C16, C23): a primary-container plate under on-primary-container words, where it was a thin primary outline; --sf-steps-current-border-color still draws a border where a page sets one, and its stated default is transparent. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-12, R185 steps study, ui-control control/research/2026-11-12-steps.md, the items the study names independent of the open look questions): a minor. ST-13: the steps are an ordered list -- <ol class="sf-steps-container" role="list"> named by aria-label (else the language file's «Шаги» / «Steps»), one <li> per step holding its native button and the separator after it -- where they were a role group of buttons; the current step keeps aria-current=step, the root .sf-steps carries no role. The steps stay buttons and a press still moves current: a passive list without buttons waits on the owner's answer to the study's question q-click. ST-1: a label breaks between words only, never inside one (overflow-wrap normal where it was anywhere over a step that shrank to 24 px, «Кор/зина», «WordPre/ss»); a step that does not fit goes to the next line whole with its separator (the list wraps), and a label wraps between its words only when its step alone is wider than the row; sf-wizard keeps its row on one line and scrolls it, as before. ST-10 (component.step 1.2.1): the size 1/2 state icon is the size's text line, 20 on a desktop, where it drew the icon default 24 (the step gave it font-size, width and height, which the icon sheet's unlayered rule outranks; it now gives the icon's own variables); the size 1/2 gap between steps is --sf-space-1/4, as at size 1, where it was --sf-space-1/3 (8 beside 4); a step whose label fits stands at its control height in a narrow row too, where wrapped labels grew it to 74-122 px. The side padding and the other rungs wait on the look questions. Settings, values, events, actions and keys unchanged; a page rule that read .sf-steps-container > button or > .sf-icon reads .sf-steps-container > li > button and .sf-steps-separator.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-12, owner decision C101 on the R185 steps study, ui-control control/research/2026-11-12-steps.md and prototypes/steps-study.html): a minor; the old forms are read with dated notes until 2027-01-01. (1) Role: an ordered process a person goes through; a server job is sf-progress-run, tasks in any order are a task list. (2) Look: a marker, the label in whole words and a line to the next step -- 2 px of the progress colour behind current, 1 px outline-variant after it; the pills, the separator glyph and separator-icon are gone (ST-6, ST-7). (3) marker: number (default; a check when done, priority_high on an error) or dot (the .sf-dot ladder, 8 / 6); the marker box is the rung's text line, 24 at size 1 and 20 at 1/2 (ST-8, ST-10). (4) layout: auto (default) is a row while it fits its own width on one line, a column with the second line (item text) otherwise, and under 20rem of its own width the count line «Шаг N из M · label» over sf-progress-bar 1/3 as sf-wizard's compact head; row, column and count draw always (ST-1, ST-2, ST-9). (5) Passive by default: the steps are an ol with aria-current=step on the current item and a state word in each item (sr-only), no buttons; navigation visited or free makes the reachable steps native buttons, as in sf-wizard, and only a pressed button sends sf-steps-change (ST-3, ST-13). (6) State by shape and the primary colour (C61, C73): done filled with a check, current filled with a 2 px ring through a 2 px gap, ahead empty, error the error colour, skipped a dashed outline, running the Framework spinner (sf-spinner at the rung's size, centred, no ring); current equal to the number of steps is all done, no step current (ST-4); no green in the steps, a success status of the whole job is the host's (ST-5). (7) One list format: items as JSON with a state per item; the item state words are done, ahead, skipped, running and error (completed and default are read as done and ahead), the string form label::flag|label and error-step are the old form, separator-icon is ignored -- each use is noted in SF.deprecations, since 2026-11-12, remove after 2027-01-01 (ST-12). New words current-label «Текущий» / «Current», ahead-label «Впереди» / «Not started», count-label «Шаг {n} из {count}» / «Step {n} of {count}». Public variables keep their names and read the new drawing: --sf-steps-gap the space between steps of a row, --sf-steps-separator-color the line after current, --sf-steps-step-color the label and number ahead, --sf-steps-step-border-color the empty marker's outline, --sf-steps-step-radius the marker's corners, --sf-steps-current-border-color the current ring, --sf-steps-completed-icon-color the progress colour (done and current markers, the line behind current). Relations add cl-spinner, cl-progress-bar and sr-only/default. sf-wizard draws its row with layout="row" navigation="free" and today's state words.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-steps to show where a person is in an ordered process they go through (checkout, a setup, a form in steps, an order's status). Not for a server job (sf-progress-run) or tasks done in any order (a task list).
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: Passive by default: no step is focusable. With navigation, each reachable step is a native button reached by Tab, with the shared focus-visible indicator. The current item has aria-current=step; every item carries its state word for a screen reader.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute; an array (items) is written as JSON. false, null, undefined or empty removes the attribute, true sets it empty.

onStepChange.summary: Adds a listener for sf-steps-change; the handler is called with (current, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

aria-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Steps" in English).
